map.眼压角膜厚度多公式校正：Ehlers = IOP +（520 − CCT）× 0: Multi-formula IOP/CCT correction: Ehlers = IOP + (520 - CCT) × 0.071; Doughty = IOP + (542 - CCT) × 0.020; Feltgen = IOP + (550 - CCT) × 0.030; ratio method = IOP × 520 / CCT; take the mean and extremes of the four; CCT <500µm makes the reading biased low.
map.说明：Goldmann 设计基准约为 520μm，偏厚会高估、偏薄会低估眼压。各: Note: Goldmann's design baseline is about 520µm; thicker overestimates and thinner underestimates IOP. The coefficients come from different studies and are for reference.
map.⚠️ 角膜厚度校正仅为估算，个体差异大，不能仅凭校正值诊断或排除青光眼。需结合视: ⚠️ Corneal-thickness correction is only an estimate with large individual variation; diagnosis or exclusion of glaucoma cannot rest on it alone. Combine optic nerve, visual field, etc., and see an ophthalmologist.
